answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 8316 Country: India Title: Assalaam alai kum, Respected Mufti Sahab, My question is that, what is the permissible method of avoiding child birth, in Islam? Can my wife use copper-T ? Please advise as soon as possible. Allah Hafiz. Question: Assalaam alai kum, Respected Mufti Sahab, My question is that, what is the permissible method of avoiding child birth, in Islam? Can my wife use copper-T ? Please advise as soon as possible. Allah Hafiz. Answer ID: 8316 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 6144/1736=B/1429) If her health is weak, she unable to bear the hardships of pregnancy, she fears unbearable troubles in case of pregnancy, or any religious Muslim expert doctor diagnoses it, then in all such cases, it will be allowed to use contraceptives temporarily like pill, condoms, ointment etc for the recovery of health. If there are no such cases, then it will not be allowed to use these contraceptive methods temporarily as well, and it will be against the will of the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
